svg.title: NATO (1949–55), Rearmed West Germany and the Warsaw Pact (May 1955)
svg.desc: Conic-projection GIS historical atlas map of Europe showing NATO members (1949–52), West Germany joining NATO in May 1955, the rival Soviet-led Warsaw Pact established on 14 May 1955 across the USSR and seven Eastern European states, and neutral/non-aligned European nations.
